card_krueger.authors: David Card and Alan B. Krueger
transformations: Read the fixed-width source using the codebook column positions.
Treat the source dot missing codes as missing; retain all 410 restaurants.
Select and rename 13 columns; derive store_id from state and source_sheet because source SHEET=407 occurs in both states. Verify 410 unique composite identifiers.
No employment aggregation, imputation, or row removal in the distributed CSV.
card_krueger.measurement: FTE = full-time employees + managers + 0.5 * part-time employees; calculation is an exercise.

cultural_domain_examples.status: Fully synthetic teaching fixtures authored for this course; no human participants.
cultural_domain_examples.construction: Explicitly authored variable-length lists; two within-list synonym duplicates and inconsistent case/spacing. Age groups have eight fictional respondents each. Six pile templates repeat across the 24 fictional respondents; all sort the same eight cards.
cultural_domain_examples.interpretation: Demonstrate methods only; no population or public-service findings can be inferred.

training_example.units: Monthly earnings in arbitrary currency units, not real salaries.
training_example.generation: Age uniform integers 20..60; baseline earnings clipped normal(2500,650); unemployment months uniform integers 0..18. Participation probability uses logit=-0.2+0.025*(age-40)-0.001*(earnings_before-2500)+0.07*(unemployment_months-9). Outcome=400+0.8*earnings_before+12*age-25*unemployment_months+300*training+normal(0,300).
training_example.interpretation: The simulation's fixed effect does not guarantee a finite-sample matching estimate equals it; no real programme claim.
